_purpose: Names and plain-language descriptions for the kinds of document a benefit notice commonly asks for. Used by the Checklist to label a requirement and to offer a list when the user adds one themselves.
_not_a_rule: THESE ARE DESCRIPTIONS, NOT REQUIREMENTS. CLAUDE.md section 16 forbids inventing a rule about what a programme requires. Nothing in this file says any programme needs any of these. A checklist row may only be presented as 'the letter asks for this' when the extraction cascade read it off the notice; a row built from this list is presented as something the user added. If a future change starts keying this file on programme or action type, that change has turned a vocabulary into a rule and must not ship.
_translation_note: PARTIALLY SOURCED, AND NOT FROM CDSS. Three terms come from San Mateo County's Spanish-language SAR 7 guide ('Como completar el SAR 7', adapted from San Diego County): 'servicios publicos' for utilities, 'comprobante'/'prueba' for proof, and 'gastos medicos' for medical expenses. That is COUNTY wording, not state wording. Everything else in label_es/what_es is Carta's own. See src/lib/i18n/SOURCES.md for the full provenance map.
_translation_todo: Get SAR 7 (SP) and SAR 7A (SP) from the browser, copy the wording each uses for the proof items, and replace label_es/what_es with it. Then have a fluent Spanish speaker read the result. Accents are correct and three county terms are applied; what remains is whose words these are.

doc_types.label: Pay stub
doc_types.what: A paper or printout from a job showing what was paid and when.
doc_types.what_es: Un papel o impresión del trabajo que muestra cuánto se pagó y cuándo.

doc_types.label: Letter from an employer
doc_types.what: A signed note from a job, used when there are no pay stubs.
doc_types.what_es: Una nota firmada del trabajo, que se usa cuando no hay talones de pago.

doc_types.label: Rent receipt or lease
doc_types.label_es: Recibo de renta o contrato de arrendamiento
doc_types.what: Proof of what is paid for housing, and to whom.
doc_types.what_es: Comprobante de lo que se paga por la vivienda, y a quién.

doc_types.label: Utility bill
doc_types.what: A gas, electric, water, or phone bill.
doc_types.what_es: Una factura de gas, electricidad, agua o teléfono.

doc_types.label: Bank statement
doc_types.what: A statement from a bank or credit union.
doc_types.what_es: Un estado de cuenta de un banco o cooperativa de crédito.

doc_types.label: Photo ID
doc_types.what: A driver license, state ID, passport, or consular ID.
doc_types.what_es: Una licencia de conducir, identificación estatal, pasaporte o matrícula consular.

doc_types.label: Social Security card
doc_types.what: The card itself. Carta never stores the number.
doc_types.what_es: La tarjeta misma. Carta nunca guarda el número.

doc_types.label: Medical bill or receipt
doc_types.label_es: Factura o recibo de gastos médicos
doc_types.what: A bill or receipt for care, medicine, or insurance.
doc_types.what_es: Una factura o recibo por atención médica, medicinas o seguro.

doc_types.label: Child care receipt
doc_types.what: Proof of what is paid for child care, and to whom.
doc_types.what_es: Comprobante de lo que se paga por el cuidado de niños, y a quién.

doc_types.label: School record
doc_types.what: Proof that a child is enrolled, or a school schedule.
doc_types.what_es: Comprobante de que un niño está inscrito, o un horario escolar.

doc_types.label: Immigration document
doc_types.what: A card, letter, or notice from an immigration agency.
doc_types.what_es: Una tarjeta, carta o aviso de una agencia de inmigración.

doc_types.label: Something else
doc_types.what: Anything the letter asks for that is not on this list.
doc_types.what_es: Cualquier cosa que la carta pida y que no esté en esta lista.

_translation_blocker: STILL BLOCKED as of 2026-08-24, even though two CDSS Spanish forms are now committed under tools/forms/spanish/. Neither one covers this file. CF 377.6 (SP) is a Notice of Action asking for information -- it carries notice-level vocabulary (Numero del caso, Fecha de la notificacion, Nombre del caso) and no list of what to send. CF 30 (SP) is the SAR 7 REMINDER notice, sent when a SAR 7 is missing; it gives the form's official Spanish name ('Reporte sobre el estado de elegibilidad (SAR 7)') and, again, no document checklist. The required-document vocabulary lives in SAR 7 (SP) -- its 'proof you must send' section -- and in SAR 7A (SP), the instruction sheet. Neither has been obtained. cdss.ca.gov returns a 302 to a dead host for automated requests (CLAUDE.md section 13), so this is a manual browser step. DO NOT mark these strings verified until one of those two forms is in tools/forms/spanish/ and its wording has actually been copied across.
_verified_on_note: _verified_on refers to when this vocabulary was written, not to a source. There is no source_url because a list of ordinary nouns makes no claim needing one (see _not_a_rule). The Spanish is a different question and is tracked by _translation_blocker.
